name: Wasco Berhad
overview: Wasco Berhad 今年宣布以 1.92825 亿美元（约 7.8219 亿马币）现金出售其 Engineering and Fabrication 部门给 NMDC Energy PJSC，并完成两家间接全资子公司的成员自愿清盘。公司同时宣派 2025 财年特别股息与第二次中期股息，以及 2026 财年第一次中期股息。
overview_en: Wasco Berhad announced the proposed disposal of its Engineering and Fabrication Division to NMDC Energy PJSC for a total cash consideration of USD192,825,000 (approximately RM782,194,613), and completed the member's voluntary winding up of two indirect wholly-owned subsidiaries. The company also declared a special dividend and second interim dividend for FY2025, and a first interim dividend for FY2026.

segments.name: 能源服务
segments.note: 该部门属于能源服务业务下的工程与制造环节。
segments.note_en: This year, the company proposed to dispose of its Engineering and Fabrication Division, which is part of the engineering and fabrication activities under Energy Services.
